title: flow-hero patch
description: Settings for a flow-hero background (flow-hero 0.2.0). Every key is optional: missing keys come from the preset or the default, out-of-range numbers are clamped, and unknown keys are dropped.

name.title: Name
name.description: A label for the look. Not used for rendering.

colors.title: Colours
colors.description: Two to four gradient stops, blended in OKLab.

angle.title: Angle
angle.description: Gradient direction in CSS degrees (0 points up, 90 points right).

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: How far the stops drift back and forth over time.

color.title: Colour
color.description: The accent colour of the trail.

hueShift.title: Hue shift
hueShift.description: How far the ink hue swings away from the accent. Stroke direction varies the swing. 0 is pure accent.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: Brightness (or darkness, for multiply) of the ink.

size.title: Brush size
size.description: Largest brush radius, as a fraction of the short side. Fast strokes reach it.

lifetime.title: Lifetime
lifetime.description: Seconds until a trail is about gone. Time-based, so 60 Hz and 120 Hz match.

drift.title: Drift
drift.description: How far ink keeps travelling along its stroke direction.

blend.title: Blend
blend.description: add glows on dark, screen glows softly, multiply darkens light backgrounds.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Strength of the turbulence the image is resampled through. This is what makes smoke billow.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Size of the turbulence. Higher is finer.

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: How fast the turbulence field drifts and evolves.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Noise octaves. Fewer is cheaper and smoother.

grain.title: Grain
grain.description: Film grain. A little stops banding on dark gradients.

mode.title: Wanderer
mode.description: off never draws on its own. attract draws until the visitor first moves the pointer, and comes back after a pause only on touch devices. always draws after every pause.

size.title: Size
size.description: Wanderer brush size relative to Brush size.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: Render scale for the warp pass. The ink simulation runs at half of this.

maxDpr.title: Max DPR
maxDpr.description: Caps device pixel ratio so large retina screens stay cheap.
